definition_used: The article has an expression of concern after this notice.
caution: This is a status/notice term indicating an expression of concern has been added, not a direct cause. It signals transparency but does not confirm a specific integrity problem.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes a post-publication notice (expression of concern) added to the article, which falls under post-publication transparency and due process oversight. It does not directly assert issues with research content, authorship, or editorial governance, though it may be associated with such concerns.
